name: 10 nin Yaru! ~Soshite Densetsu e~
source:
"I want to be human," thought Killing Machine sadly.

One day in Alefgard, it decided to take fate into its robo-hands. Killing Machine went in search of the Holy Pr*ck item.

Folklore says that whoever f*cks 10 vaginas with this item can become human!

[From DLsite English]
translation:
“我想变成人类……”杀戮机器悲伤地想道。

在阿雷夫加尔德的某一天，它决定用自己的机械双手掌握命运。杀戮机器踏上了寻找神器“神圣肉棒”的旅途。

民间传说记载，无论是谁，只要用这件道具干满10个小穴，就能脱胎换骨变成真正的人类！
